claims.claim: Phase 1 tools accept no credential material and perform no authenticated platform request.
Every MCP tool is read only and no MCP tool can connect, publish, message, moderate, spend, deploy, approve, or promote.
Each platform operation is API_ALLOWED, ATTENDED_MANUAL, or DENY, and unavailable API capability never falls back to computer use.

Optimization evaluation and the bounded autopilot can only reject or queue digest bound candidates for independent verification; review eligibility, execution, promotion, and self mutation remain unauthorized.
